Water Goes Bad
Maximum Days Until Water Goes Bad
In days, the latest the water can go bad. This only starts counting after the water shutoff.
Minimum Days Until Water Goes Bad
In days, the earliest the water can go bad. This only starts counting after the water shutoff.
Minimum Remaining Water
Amount of water that will not be drained from taps by as a fraction of their total capacity. For example, if this value is 0.2, a tap will not drain past 20%% of its total capacity.
Plumbed Sinks Need Filters
Players must add filters to their plumbed sinks to clean the water. Otherwise, plumbed sinks are always safe water, even if their water source isn't (like vanilla).
Tap Capacity Multiplier
Multiplier to the water capacity of taps. Does not affect other liquid containers. <LINE> Changing this mid-save does not change the capacity of already loaded taps.
Water Drain Rate

How much water will be removed from each tap per day as a fraction of their total capacity. For example, if this value is 0.2, a tap will lose 20%% of its maximum water each day. Individual taps will have slight random variance from this value. <LINE> If set to 1, all taps will reach their minimum value immediately when the water shuts off. <LINE> If set to 0, water will not drain.
